recipes.name: Split alder boards
recipes.gameDescription: Split one alder log piece into four board pieces
recipes.notes: Counts are half-metre pieces: one full 1 m log block (8 pieces) splits into 32 boards.

recipes.name: Split birch boards
recipes.gameDescription: Split one birch log piece into four pale board pieces

recipes.name: Split pine boards
recipes.gameDescription: Split one pine log piece into four resinous board pieces

recipes.name: Split hardwood boards
recipes.gameDescription: Split one hardwood or deadwood piece into four boards
inputs: Hardwood or deadwood (Oak, Fruit tree, Acacia, Willow, Mangrove, Jungle, Cherry, Giant old-growth, Palm, Mesquite, Fig or Cypress log, or Deadwood)
recipes.notes: Always makes Alder boards whatever the species. Driftwood, Charred log, Mossy fallen wood, Bamboo, Cypress knees and Mangrove roots cannot be split.

recipes.name: Burn a charcoal pile
recipes.gameDescription: Smoulder four board pieces into two cooking or kiln fuels
inputs: Boards of any species (Alder, Birch or Pine boards; mixable)

recipes.name: Cook raw meat
recipes.gameDescription: Grills a raw cut over charcoal into filling cooked meat
recipes.notes: Raw meat restores 8 hunger, Cooked meat 30.

recipes.name: Roast venison
recipes.gameDescription: Roasts lean venison over charcoal for a full meal
recipes.notes: One Venison (18 hunger raw) becomes 2 Cooked meat (30 each).

recipes.name: Blow glass flasks
recipes.gameDescription: Two empty flasks; press T at fresh water to fill them
recipes.notes: 8 Glass pieces = one full glass block. Fill flasks by pressing T near drinkable water.

recipes.name: Fire glass
recipes.gameDescription: Fires shore sand over charcoal into clear building glass
recipes.notes: 3 blocks of Pale sand make 2 blocks of Glass. Only Pale sand works (not Sea, Fine dune, Red, Black or Shell sand). Besides this recipe, the Survey workshop landmark's one-time find gives 8 Glass.

recipes.name: Kiln-fire gray brick
recipes.gameDescription: Bakes river clay into hard courtyard brick
recipes.notes: No kiln block exists; the recipe is crafted from the pack like every other.

recipes.name: Glaze roof tile
recipes.gameDescription: Glazes clay with sand ash into weatherproof roof tile

recipes.name: Burn lime plaster
recipes.gameDescription: Burns limestone into smooth whitewashed plaster
recipes.notes: Only Limestone counts (Sharp limestone does not).

recipes.name: Dress carved stone
recipes.gameDescription: Dress any natural stone into fine building stone
inputs: Natural stone (any of 26 natural stones; mixable)

recipes.name: Cut sandstone
recipes.gameDescription: Compacts two blocks of loose sand into one of sandstone

recipes.name: Lacquer timber
recipes.gameDescription: Seals boards with fired clay lacquer for structural beams
inputs: Boards of any species (Alder, Birch or Pine boards; mixable)

recipes.name: Weave paper panel
recipes.gameDescription: Presses shore reeds into a board-latticed screen panel
inputs: Boards of any species (Alder, Birch or Pine boards; mixable)
recipes.notes: Only Reeds count (Tall reeds do not).

recipes.name: Assemble red lantern
recipes.gameDescription: A paper lantern around a lumen crystal; it lights its room
inputs: Boards of any species (Alder, Birch or Pine boards; mixable)
recipes.notes: Makes half a block of lantern (4 pieces). Needs Lumen crystal, which does not generate naturally: the only piece in a survival world sits at the Stone overlook landmark, so this recipe cannot be completed from gathered materials alone.

recipes.name: Weave reed thatch
recipes.gameDescription: Bind reeds with plant fiber or wool for warm roofing
recipes.notes: Fiber comes from mining Wild flax; Wool from sheep. Raw reeds cannot stand in for the binding.

recipes.name: Dress chalk bricks
recipes.gameDescription: Cuts pale chalk into masonry blocks

recipes.name: Dress ironstone bricks
recipes.gameDescription: Cuts red ironstone into warm-colored masonry

recipes.name: Dress basalt bricks
recipes.gameDescription: Cuts volcanic basalt into dark masonry

recipes.name: Polish granite
recipes.gameDescription: Smooths coarse granite into a decorative building block
recipes.notes: Only Granite counts (Exfoliated granite does not).

recipes.name: Cover cobble with moss
recipes.gameDescription: Beds living moss into rough cobble for weathered walls

recipes.name: Stone sword
recipes.gameDescription: A dependable close-range survival weapon
inputs: Natural stone (any of 26 natural stones; mixable)
Boards of any species (Alder, Birch or Pine boards; mixable)
recipes.notes: Crafted tools are equipped automatically.

recipes.name: Stone pickaxe
recipes.gameDescription: The fastest tool for rock and crystal
inputs: Natural stone (any of 26 natural stones; mixable)
Boards of any species (Alder, Birch or Pine boards; mixable)

recipes.name: Stone hatchet
recipes.gameDescription: A broad cutting head for every timber species
inputs: Natural stone (any of 26 natural stones; mixable)
Boards of any species (Alder, Birch or Pine boards; mixable)
recipes.notes: The 4 starter boards plus 4 pieces of any natural stone (e.g. shore gravel dug by hand) make the first hatchet.

recipes.name: Stone shovel
recipes.gameDescription: A light digging tool for loose terrain
inputs: Natural stone (any of 26 natural stones; mixable)
Boards of any species (Alder, Birch or Pine boards; mixable)

recipes.name: Alder bow
recipes.gameDescription: A hunting bow bound with plant fiber or wool
inputs: Boards of any species (Alder, Birch or Pine boards; mixable)

recipes.name: Reed-bound bow
recipes.gameDescription: Twisted wetland reeds make a bowstring without animal drops
inputs: Boards of any species (Alder, Birch or Pine boards; mixable)
recipes.notes: Same Alder bow as the fiber/wool recipe, without animal drops.

recipes.name: Four arrows
recipes.gameDescription: Stone-tipped arrows stabilized with feathers
inputs: Natural stone (any of 26 natural stones; mixable)
Boards of any species (Alder, Birch or Pine boards; mixable)

recipes.name: Four reed arrows
recipes.gameDescription: Reed shafts and vanes replace feathers for early hunting
inputs: Natural stone (any of 26 natural stones; mixable)
Boards of any species (Alder, Birch or Pine boards; mixable)

recipes.name: Four throwing rocks
recipes.gameDescription: Knapped hand stones; equip and hurl them at game
inputs: Natural stone (any of 26 natural stones; mixable)
recipes.notes: Each Throwing rock weighs 0.6 kg versus 0.125 kg per stone piece, so crafting rocks raises carried mass.

recipes.name: Alder rifle
recipes.gameDescription: A stable shoulder-fired hunting rifle with automatic reload
inputs: Natural stone (any of 26 natural stones; mixable)
Boards of any species (Alder, Birch or Pine boards; mixable)
recipes.notes: 40 stone = 5 blocks, 16 boards = 2 blocks, 8 Lumen crystal = 1 block. Needs Lumen crystal, which does not generate naturally: the only piece in a survival world sits at the Stone overlook landmark, so this recipe cannot be completed from gathered materials alone.

recipes.name: Four rifle rounds
recipes.gameDescription: Stone rifle shot with measured lumen propellant
inputs: Natural stone (any of 26 natural stones; mixable)
recipes.notes: Needs Lumen crystal, which does not generate naturally: the only piece in a survival world sits at the Stone overlook landmark, so this recipe cannot be completed from gathered materials alone.

recipes.name: TNT charge
recipes.gameDescription: A bounded terrain-clearing charge ignited with G
inputs: Boards of any species (Alder, Birch or Pine boards; mixable)
recipes.notes: Makes one full TNT block (8 pieces). Needs Lumen crystal, which does not generate naturally: the only piece in a survival world sits at the Stone overlook landmark, so this recipe cannot be completed from gathered materials alone.

recipes.name: Two dynamite sticks
recipes.gameDescription: Repacks a charge into thrown sticks with paper casing
recipes.notes: Needs half a block of TNT, which itself needs Lumen crystal (see TNT charge).

recipes.name: Small sailing boat
recipes.gameDescription: A wooden dinghy with woven plant-fiber sails; launch on water
inputs: Boards of any species (Alder, Birch or Pine boards; mixable)
recipes.notes: Listed last in the Timber section. Crafting selects the boat ready to launch; it weighs 18 kg.
